# [STORY] As a Presenter, I want zero-touch automated live demo orchestration for 1-command deployment

## User Story
**As an** Presenter / Developer
**I want** zero-touch, 100% automated orchestration for both cloud and local live showcase pipelines
**So that** I can spin up, connect, and tear down the entire stack with a single command or button click with zero manual copy-pasting, zero manual configuration, and zero setup friction.

## Parent Epic
Parent: #136

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a local startup request, when running `start-infrastructure.sh --tunnel` or `start-live-demo.sh`, then the stack and public HTTPS tunnel launch together automatically without extra commands.
- [x] Given a teardown request, when running `stop-infrastructure.sh`, then all containers, background processes, and tunnels are cleanly terminated.
- [x] Given the Vercel frontend, when launching either cloud or local backends, then Dynamic DNS automatically routes traffic to the active backend with zero frontend rebuilds.
- [x] Given a Vercel deployment, when running `deploy-vercel.sh`, then the frontend builds and deploys to Vercel automatically.
